source: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, Earth Information Center visualizations

tracks.title: Active Fires As Observed by VIIRS, 2024–Present
tracks.credits: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. Visualizer: Trent L. Schindler (USRA). Scientist: Doug C. Morton (NASA/GSFC).
tracks.dataset: VIIRS active fires (fire radiative power), moving 5-day window, over Blue Marble
tracks.activeRule: land pixels where VIIRS saw fire in the 5-day window

tracks.title: Sea Level Through a Porthole (2023)
tracks.credits: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. Visualizer: AJ Christensen (SSAI).
tracks.dataset: Global mean sea level, TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason-1, OSTM/Jason-2 and Jason-3, 1993–2023
tracks.activeRule: porthole pixels below the water line

tracks.title: TEMPO – Nitrogen Dioxide Air Pollution Over North America
tracks.credits: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. Data provided by the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian. Visualizers: Kel Elkins, Trent L. Schindler (USRA), Cindy Starr (GST).
tracks.dataset: TEMPO tropospheric NO2 column, hourly daylight scans, August 28–31, 2023
tracks.activeRule: observed air at or above 5 ×10¹⁵ molec/cm² (same threshold as side A)

tracks.title: Global Atmospheric Methane (CH₄)
tracks.credits: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. Visualizers: Helen-Nicole Kostis (USRA), AJ Christensen (SSAI). Scientists: Lesley Ott (NASA/GSFC), Brad Weir (Morgan State University).
tracks.dataset: NASA GEOS model atmospheric methane, volumetric, through 2021
tracks.activeRule: globe pixels inside the dense purple methane haze
